title: The long summer
text: The family has a whole summer. His uncle has a place near Bangkok and says the boy can come out, a cousin goes to a jiu-jitsu kids' class every afternoon, or there's the tennis camp his mum has already paid for.

choices.text: A summer with his uncle near Bangkok.
choices.outcome: A camp down the road lets him hit pads with the Thai kids. He comes home brown, skinny and kicking.

person.about: Moved to Thailand years ago and knows everyone at the local camp.

choices.text: Jiu-jitsu with his cousin every afternoon.
choices.outcome: He gets stuck under bigger kids all summer and learns to wriggle out. By August he's the one on top.

person.about: Two years older, a blue belt already, and never lets him forget it.

choices.text: The tennis camp his mum paid for.
choices.outcome: He's good at it and bored by it. He reads about fighters on his phone between lessons.
